# quickwit_field_text (Data Source)

Builds a `text` field mapping.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "quickwit_field_text" "message" {
  name       = "message"
  tokenizer  = "default"
  record     = "position"
  fieldnorms = true
}

data "quickwit_field_text" "host" {
  name            = "host"
  tokenizer       = "raw"
  fast_normalizer = "lowercase"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Field name. Dots must be escaped (`\\.`) to be part of the name.

### Optional

- `array` (Boolean) Map an array of values (`array<T>`). Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the field.
- `fast` (Boolean) Store the field in a columnar fast field (sorting, aggregations). Defaults to `false`.
- `fast_normalizer` (String) Normalizer of the fast field (`raw` or `lowercase`). Implies `fast = true`; defaults to `raw` when `fast = true`.
- `fieldnorms` (Boolean) Store field norms (needed for BM25 length normalization). Defaults to `false`.
- `indexed` (Boolean) Index the field (make it searchable). Defaults to `true`.
- `record` (String) What the inverted index records: `basic` (doc ids), `freq` (+ term frequencies) or `position` (+ positions, needed for phrase queries). Defaults to `basic`.
- `stored` (Boolean) Store the value in the doc store. Defaults to `true`.
- `tokenizer` (String) Tokenizer name: a built-in one (`raw`, `default`, `en_stem`, `whitespace`, `chinese_compatible`, `source_code_default`, `lowercase`…) or a custom `quickwit_tokenizer`. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) Canonical JSON document (all defaults explicit, keys sorted), as returned by Quickwit.
